jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Product Manager at Handoff

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap, strategy, and execution of a core product squad. In this role, you’ll lead engineers and designers to ship high-quality, high-impact features that improve contractor workflows, while connecting product decisions to measurable business and growth outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong product mindset with customer obsession and a high bar for execution. You should be energized by complexity, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a fast-paced, AI-driven startup solving real-world problems for builders and remodelers.

What you’ll do

  • Own the squad roadmap, strategy, and execution for a core product area.
  • Conduct continuous customer discovery - interviews, prototypes, field visits - and turn insights into clear specs, user stories, and priorities.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to iterate quickly and deliver intuitive, polished experiences.
  • Define adoption, activation, and retention metrics; set up tracking, analyze performance, and iterate based on data.
  • Produce and update our roadmap and communicate product direction across leadership and GTM teams.
  • Translate features into benefits and customer outcomes, supporting sales, marketing, and onboarding with clear collateral.
  • Sweat the details - QA, polish, and validate every flow and edge case before launch.
  • Apply Handoff’s product principles - simplemaxxing, mobile-first, AI-first, and customer-obsession - to every design, feature, and product decision

About you

  • 3-5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in vertical SaaS.
  • Experience building B2B SaaS products; with AI experience strongly preferred.
  • Track record of shipping 0→1 or early-stage features.
  • Strong skills in customer discovery, research, and ruthless prioritization.
  • Proven ability to work hand-in-hand with engineers and designers in agile environments.
  • Excellent writing and communication - able to produce crisp specs, epics, and roadmap docs.
  • Excitement about construction, remodeling, and home services - genuine curiosity about contractors’ world.
  • Bonus experience: CRM, project management tools, payments/fintech, AI-driven products, or PLG (product-led growth).
  • Startup DNA - comfort in ambiguity, bias for action, stamina for fast-moving environments.

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary + Equity
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Dependent Care FSA (DC FSA)
  • Relocation Allowance
  • Top-Notch Equipment
  • Team Offsites

Продукти KMA це світові лідери в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health&fitness — AI Remodel, Printer, Botan, Calorie Counter і не тільки. Це продукти, що займають топ-1 місця App Store й вирішують потреби комʼюніті з сотень мільйонів людей.

Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року — і ми шукаємо Lead Product Manager, того/ту, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше.

Коротко про роль:

Шукаємо Lead Product Manager, який(а) очолить розвиток одного з наших AI-driven застосунків на ринку, що активно зростає. Це роль із повним ownership за результат продукту — від формування продуктової стратегії до масштабування growth-каналів.

Наші продукти вже мають підтверджений product-market fit і значний потенціал кратного зростання. Твоя задача — знайти та оптимізувати робочу юніт-економіку, вибудувати системний процес продуктових експериментів і масштабувати продукт через продуктову розробку та performance-маркетинг.

Ця роль для людини, яка хоче не просто підтримувати існуючий продукт, а драйвити його масштабування, впливати на ключові метрики бізнесу та будувати продукт із потенціалом стати флагманом у своїй ніші.

Твої задачі:

  • Визначення продуктової та growth-стратегії для масштабування.

  • Пошук і стабілізація юніт-економіки продукту: pricing, paywall, retention, acquisition та ключові продуктові метрики.

  • Побудова системного процесу продуктових експериментів для зростання revenue та масштабування продукту.

  • Управління продуктовою командою та формування чітких цілей розвитку продукту.

  • Тісна робота з маркетингом для масштабування закупки трафіку (Meta, CPA-мережі та інші канали).

  • Прийняття ключових рішень по продукту: стратегія, позиціонування, монетизація, roadmap та розвиток команди.

Що очікуємо від тебе:

  • Досвід роботи з мобільними застосунками та розуміння специфіки mobile-ринку.

  • Практичний досвід масштабування продуктів або запуску нових продуктів з відчутним growth-результатом.

  • Сильна експертиза у продуктовій аналітиці та юніт-економіці.

  • Розуміння performance-маркетингу та досвід роботи з каналами платного трафіку (Meta, CPA networks тощо).

  • Досвід роботи з subscription-моделями монетизації.

Ми точно заметчимось, якщо ти не боїшся приймати сміливі рішення, ризикувати та завжди досягаєш своєї мети.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Формат роботи на твій вибір: fully remote з будь-якої точки вільного світу, а також доступ до одного з наших офісів за бажанням (Київ, Варшава).

  • Умови, завдяки яким ти можеш сфокусуватись на перформ

jobs.desc:
About Versapay 

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!




How you’ll make an impact here – and on your career: 

Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Senior Product Manager, Payments, you will own the end-to-end payments product and experience, from customer-facing workflows through underlying processing, settlement, and partner integrations. 
In this role, you will be accountable for the vision, strategy, and delivery of our payments capabilities, with a particular focus on our payment processing gateway and broader payments ecosystem. You will operate with a holistic mindset—owning outcomes across reliability, usability, scalability, and commercial performance—rather than isolated features. 
This role pairs deep payments domain ownership with modern product management practices. You will lead end-to-end product development, drive customer and business value through data-informed decisions, and collaborate across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative payments experiences. You will also regularly represent the payments product strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment decisions. 
This is an opportunity for a product leader who thrives in complexity, is energized by ambiguity, and is excited to help grow and modernize a global payments platform. 

What you'll do:

    • Product Strategy & Vision 
    • Own and articulate a clear product vision and strategy for payments, aligned with company objectives and growth plans.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Kindred is a members-only home swapping platform that unlocks the ability to live a travel-rich lifestyle through the power of community. By exchanging primary residences with trusted peers, renters and owners alike can match with Kindred spirits and explore new destinations without breaking the bank.

Kindred is revolutionizing the “third option” of travel accommodation, compared to short-term rentals and hotels. Since launching in 2022, Kindred has grown to a global community of 300,000 members across 150+ cities and puts home swapping on the map as a radically more affordable, responsible, and connected way to travel.

To support that momentum, Kindred has raised over $150M in capital from some of the most credible investors in Silicon Valley, including Index Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, New Enterprise Associates, Bessemer Venture Partners, Caffeinated Capital, Elad Gil, and founders of companies like Opendoor, Figma, ClassPass, and more.

Kindred’s co-founders are proven leaders from the early team at Opendoor ($15B+ exit), who have each built and scaled products that today generate $1B+ annual revenue combined.

We’re looking for the world’s top builders, executors, and believers to help us make travel more meaningful.

You can learn more about us in Forbes and The New York Times.

The Role:

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of travel. This is a high-impact, strategic role where you'll work closely with our co-founders and a full-stack team to solve complex, deeply human challenges—like how to make hosting your personal home feel natural, how to scale a community without compromising quality, and how to create systems that serve both sides of a marketplace.

We’re looking for someone with deep consumer intuition and empathy and an exceptionally user-centric approach to problem-solving. This is fast-paced, intellectually demanding, and emotionally meaningful work—with the potential to reshape how people travel and connect.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and lead key areas of the core product experience (e.g. growth, search & discovery, hosting) with a team of 8-10 engineers.

  • Design systems that build trust, balance marketplace dynamics, and drive measurable outcomes for both our members and the business.

  • Lead 0→1 and 1→n initiatives across surfaces that require speed, creativity, and craft.

  • Use data to size opportunities, uncover insights, and evaluate performance (both qualitative and quantitative).

  • Rigorously prioritize to focus the team on the highest-impact problems.

  • Collaborate closely with design, engineering, data and other cross-functional partners to scope, build, and ship products.

  • Champion product quality, simplicity, and craft.

  • Deeply understand and advocate for member needs.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Job description

Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling.

DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally.

We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be - moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys.

If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place.

The Role

We are looking for Senior Growth Product Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing the subscription lifecycle and monetization mechanics. In this role, you will focus on improving conversion, ARPU, and retention through experimentation, pricing strategy, and product-led growth initiatives.

What You Will Do

  • Own and optimize the subscription funnel: join pages, paywalls, free flows and trials, upgrades, renewals

  • Develop and iterate on pricing, packaging, and upsell/order bumps strategies to maximize LTV per user

  • Lead initiatives around churn reduction, cancellation flows, and retention mechanics

  • Design and run A/B tests to improve conversion, LTV, and monetization efficiency

  • Work with user segmentation and behavioral data to personalize offers and pricing

  • Collaborate with engineering, data, and marketing teams to ship growth experiments and monetization features

  • Define hypotheses, analyze results, and scale successful growth initiatives

  • Continuously track and improve subscription metrics and reporting (conversion, ARPU, churn, LTV)

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ Years Experience as a Growth Product Manager or Monetization PM

  • Strong understanding of subscription business models and revenue mechanics

  • Ability to work with data, experiments, and product analytics to drive decisions

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
jobs.desc:
Payabli is a next-generation Payments Infrastructure and Monetization Platform purpose-built for vertical software companies. Through a single, developer-friendly API with low-code embedded payment components, Payabli enables platforms to seamlessly embed, monetize, and operationalize payments—making payments a core part of their platform and business model.

By unifying payment acceptance, payment issuance, and advanced payment operations tooling, Payabli empowers software companies to manage and move money through a single infrastructure stack that delivers total control over the payments experience. Built to scale with PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2-compliant security, Payabli’s infrastructure delivers enterprise-grade reliability and trust while leveraging AI-driven intelligence to enhance visibility, streamline operations, and drive revenue growth.

Backed by leading fintech investors including QED Investors, Fika Ventures, TTV Capital, and Bling Capital, Payabli is setting the standard for embedded payments infrastructure powering the next generation of vertical SaaS.

We're seeking a Senior Product Manager, Platform to own and evolve the foundational services that every product at Payabli depends on. From identity and authentication to embedded components, tokenization, and notification systems—you'll be the connective tissue between engineering and the rest of the organization, ensuring our platform is secure, scalable, and built to last.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage from the sidelines. You'll run to the fire, own the outcomes, and build the infrastructure that makes everything else at Payabli possible.

What You'll Do

  • Identity & Access Management Lead the strategy and execution of our identity platform, spanning both authentication and authorization. You'll define how users and API consumers prove who they are and what they're allowed to do—two fundamentally different problems that require distinct architectures. This includes SSO management, multi-tenant permissions models, and API authentication and authorization. You understand that identity is the front door to every product we build.

  • Embedded Components & Creator Suite Own the foundational suite of embeddable components that our platform partners use to build financial experiences. You'll drive the strategy for our component library—from white-labeled UI elements to drop-in workflows—ensuring our partners can go live faster with less engineering effort. This requires experience building embeddable systems and a deep appreciation for developer experience.

  • Tokenization Services Own the cross-cutting tokenization layer that serves multiple product lines. Tokenization underpins payment security, funding account protection, and data privacy across the entire platform. You'll work across teams to ensure a unified approach to sensitive data handling that scales with our growth and meets compliance requirements.

  • Communications & Compliance Own the notification system and communication channels that keep our platform running. This includes managing SMS as a channel—including 10DLC compliance in the US—email delivery, and other messaging infrastructure. You understand that communication channels aren't just features; they're regulated services that require proper compliance management and ongoing maintenance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Cluster Linking
jobs.desc:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About the Role:

Cluster Linking is how Kafka clusters are replicated, and it sits at the very core of Confluent. When a global bank architects zero-data-loss disaster recovery, when an enterprise migrates petabytes off open-source Kafka, or when a multinational replicates event streams across three continents, they're running on Cluster Linking.

This role will define the future of Cluster Linking: how we deliver seamless disaster recovery for Kafka workloads, how we build self-service migration paths into Confluent Cloud, and how we enable cross-organization data sharing to power real-time, operational data exchanges.

Cluster Linking is one of Confluent's fastest-growing platform products and you'll own that growth. Our largest customers depend on it, and because it cuts across Kafka, cloud infrastructure, networking, and security, your work will have visibility and influence across the company.

What You Will Do:

  • Launch and drive adoption for our one-click DR initiative. Take disaster recovery from a manually configured capability to a seamless, productized experience that customers can adopt with confidence.

  • Define the future of real-time stream sharing across organizations, including its security model, networking, access controls, and how it scales across organizations and use cases.

  • Power capabilities that let customers migrate to Confluent in a few clicks or API calls. Define the art of the possible and make the migration path a reason to choose Confluent.

  • Segment and re-package Cluster Linking. The product serves Disaster Recovery, migrations, data sharing, and cross-cloud replication, each with different customer needs and pricing dynamics. Define how we package, price, and position each so the offering works for customers and drives growth.

  • Partner closely with your engineering manager counterpart as a strategic partner. Use that partnership to understand tradeoffs, make decisions fast, and keep the product moving forward.

  • Work directly with customers. You'll be pulled in many directions, customers will ask a lot of you. Your job is to steer them toward the right architectures and models, get them excited about what's coming, listen to what they need next, and balance the present opportunity with where the product is headed.

  • Drive results. Run campaigns with sellers and solutions engineers, lead webinars, assemble teams of subject matter experts, and do what it takes to move your priorities forward.

  • Influence and energize the people around you. Confluent moves fast and people are ready to help. Harness that, get teams excited, rally cross-functional support, and turn organizational momentum into product momentum.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Payments
jobs.desc:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.


We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Consumer Payments to lead Toast’s consumer payments strategy and product area. This role will shape how diners pay across the Toast ecosystem, while also helping restaurants benefit from more seamless experiences, stronger guest loyalty, and improved economics.


In this role, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for consumer payment experiences at Toast. This includes card and stored value experiences, guest checkout innovation, loyalty- and rewards-linked payments, and emerging payment methods that improve both the guest experience and cost of acceptance.


You will work cross-functionally with teams across Consumer, Payments, Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Operations, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, and Go-to-Market to turn an ambitious vision into a scalable and differentiated product portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of consumer experience, payments innovation, and business strategy, and requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, leadership, and comfort operating in ambiguity.


A day in the life (Responsibilities) 



  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Consumer Payments, aligning near-term execution with Toast’s long-term strategy.

  • Define the end-to-end consumer payment experience across areas such as wallet, stored value, guest checkout, rewards-linked payments, and emerging lower-cost payment methods.

  • Partner with Consumer and Guest teams to create payment experiences that are seamless, intuitive, and habit-forming for diners across Toast surfaces.

  • Work closely with other Payment teams, Risk, Finance, Legal, and Operations teams to design solutions that are compliant, scalable, and economically compelling.

  • Drive operational readiness & reliability. Define operational playbooks, observability, edge/online failover modes, and post-launch monitoring to ensure reliable in-store behavior and low support cost.

  • Champion field research & validation. Spend time in restaurants to learn operational workflows, validate prototypes, and iterate with real staff and guests.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager

Your role

As Lead Product Manager, you will own a set of Saturn's product areas in their entirety: strategy, roadmap, commercial outcomes, and the product managers who build them.a

Saturn is a Series A, Y Combinator-backed company building the AI-native operating system for financial advice. Our platform combines a living data model of the client, AI agents that complete complex advice and operational workflows, and compliance logic embedded directly into how work is produced. The initial wedge is adviser productivity. The larger opportunity is rebuilding the operating model of the advice firm around connected data, intelligent workflows and continuous regulatory control.

This is a lead role with founder-level scope. You work directly with the CEO, engineers, partnerships, and associate product managers. You define the what and why with enough clarity that one engineer ships the whole feature. No handoff chain, no ambiguity, no hand-waving. Your work will determine whether Saturn becomes the intelligence layer through which advice is created, governed and delivered.

The Team

You will work in a cross-functional squad alongside Product Engineers who own features end-to-end across frontend, backend, and AI, plus Design and Saturn’s domain experts: chartered compliance officers and paraplanners. Product management at Saturn moves fast, and we protect that pace deliberately. The best PMs do their best work when they can see the impact of what they ship.

What You'll Work On

  • Owning the product strategy and a rolling 3-6 month roadmap for AI agents that automate advice workflows
  • Translating agentic and LLM capabilities into experiences advisers trust with regulated work, where evidence and auditability sit behind every material output
  • Running independent discovery with advisers and paraplanners, distinguishing signal from noise, and turning adviser pain into product direction
  • Prioritising ruthlessly across features, bugs, and quality, and writing specs with zero ambiguity — clear enough for one engineer to ship the whole feature
  • Balancing enterprise partner demands with product coherence, and sequencing releases against the go-to-market calendar
  • Treating go-to-market as part of the build. You ship features that land, not features that launch
  • Coaching and multiplying the PMs around you, and building the frameworks the product function adopts as it grows

What We're Looking For

  • Product management experience at fast-paced, product-led B2B SaaS companies, including ownership of a product that shipped and won in market
  • AI-native product experience. You've shipped products where AI is the core, not a bolt-on. You understand the difference between deterministic and probabilistic systems, and what it takes to put agentic workflows in front of users in a regulated environment
  • Technical fluency. You can discuss AI architecture trade-offs, know why prompts break, and challenge engineering assumptions
  • Discovery discipline and sharp prioritisation. You have run research that changed what got built, and you can explain why you said no — not just what you said yes to
  • Commercial instinct. You connect product decisions to retention, expansion, and the revenue model
  • Self-sufficiency with data. You define your own metrics and design your own experiments
  • Strong written communication. Your decision docs and PRDs reduce meetings rather than create them

Preferred

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.desc:
GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300+ colleges, universities, and K-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition-free.

GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we’re also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we’ve made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies each of the last five years and we’ve been profitable nine of the last 10. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. 

Our purpose-driven team of 130+ is located in 30+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. 

While we operate at meaningful scale, we’re still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast-growing, mission-driven company, you’ll fit right in.


Location: This is a remote-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company-wide and team-specific onsites throughout the year.

Data is the foundation of everything GiveCampus is becoming. Our fastest-growing products—GC Intelligence, GC GO, personalized Outreach, Smart Ask—only deliver their value when a school's complete data is flowing into GiveCampus and back out to the systems they run their work in. Today, that flow is the single biggest thing standing between our 1,500+ Partner schools and the value we've promised them: integration friction is the number one blocker to going live, it shows up across every CRM and deal stage, and only a fraction of schools are sending us the full data our products are built to use. Closing that gap is one of the biggest growth and retention levers in front of the company.

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to own data and integrations end-to-end—not just the roadmap, but the outcome: schools actually sending us their complete data, reliably, at scale. You'll be accountable for whether that number moves, and you'll drive everything required to move it on the product side: strategy, discovery, execution, shipping quality and velocity, reliability, activation and onboarding, and the third-party vendors and integrations that sit in the flow. You'll do it across a wide range of CRMs (Blackbaud RE NXT and BB CRM, Salesforce / Ascend, Ellucian, Veracross, Slate) and a wide range of schools—from a 2-person K-12 advancement shop to a 500-person university team. Engineering is one big input, and a critical one—but it isn't the whole job. The whole job is making the movement of data between GiveCampus and our Partners so seamless and trustworthy that adoption stops being gated on it.

jobs.desc:
FirstWork is a forward-deployed applied-AI company for frontline hiring, the largest and most heavily regulated labour market in the world. One platform carries a worker from application through onboarding, compliance verification, training and payroll, for enterprise customers across 40+ countries and a dozen-plus languages. Our AI agents run that work rather than assisting someone who still does it: document agents validate credentials against policy, browsing agents operate government portals that have no API, and voice agents screen and follow up with candidates.

The scale is live, at roughly 50,000 new applicants a week and 2.5 million API requests a day. We bill on usage, per document validated and per agent action executed, so throughput and cost show up directly in revenue.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a product line, the platform primitives beneath it, and the AI capabilities that run on top.

What you'll do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and commercial shape for a product line or platform portfolio.

  • Integrate LLMs and agentic AI deeper into the product architecture.

  • Innovate and enhance product capabilities, from new feature development to improving the maturity, accuracy and performance of existing features.

  • Build new product lines from zero, taking a validated use case to a general, multi-tenant product.

  • Decide which capabilities are assistive and which are autonomous, and set the evidence standard each must meet before acting without human review.

  • Draw the boundary between deterministic, auditable rules and model-based judgement.

  • Decide what becomes a shared platform primitive, what stays customer configuration, and what we decline to build.

  • Own accuracy and evaluation infrastructure across the portfolio, including regression detection during scale-up.

  • Own packaging, pricing and unit economics, including model cost and margin.

  • Own the audit, evidence and explainability layer that operators and auditors depend on.

  • Hire and coach product managers, and set the standard for specifications, decision records and design review.

  • Represent the product in enterprise procurement, security review and AI governance discussions.

What we look for

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including senior ownership of a platform or multi-product portfolio in B2B or enterprise software.

  • Experience platformising a complex workflow product: extracting primitives, exposing them as configuration, and moving a second segment or vertical onto them without forking.

  • Production experience with LLM or agentic systems, including ownership of accuracy, cost, latency, fallback design and autonomy decisions.

  • A track record of both zero-to-one launches and scaling an established line past its first plateau.

  • Strong technical judgement across data models, decision logic, throughput and agent architecture. This is not a functional product role.

  • Commercial fluency across pricing, packaging, margin and cost to serve.

  • Experience in a regulated domain, with judgement on when to be conservative and when to escalate to legal.

  • Experience developing product managers, as a manager or as a senior individual contributor.

  • Influence through writing and demonstrated results rather than authority.

Bonus

  • Agentic systems where an agent takes real action in an external system.

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, working directly with customers, and owning outcomes from strategy through execution, this role offers an opportunity to operate at the center of one of the fastest-growing categories in AI.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
San Francisco, CA · Full-time · In person

Screenpipe gives AI agents memory of your work. It keeps raw computer history local by default and makes that context available to the AI tools you choose.

We're looking for a senior PM who can make a powerful technical product simple and useful in everyday work.

You'll work directly with the founder and engineers, owning the path from understanding a customer's problem to shipping a change and seeing whether it helped.

What you'll own

  • Customer discovery. Talk to users regularly, watch them use the product, and understand what they are trying to get done.
  • The customer journey. Help people move from installing Screenpipe to getting a useful result and making it part of their routine.
  • Product priorities. Combine interviews, support feedback and product data to decide what matters next and what can wait.
  • Delivery. Turn problems into clear flows, prototypes and scoped work. Stay involved through implementation, release and follow-up.
  • Product outcomes. Define meaningful activation and retention measures, run focused experiments, and check whether changes improve real usage.
  • Trust. Treat privacy, permissions and clear explanations as part of the user experience.

What we're looking for

  • You've owned a software product end to end and can explain what you personally shipped, why you chose it and what happened afterward.
  • You have strong UX judgment and know how to test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're comfortable with product analytics, funnels and cohorts, including questioning how a metric is defined.
  • You can use AI tools to investigate problems and build prototypes, and work closely with engineers on technical tradeoffs.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and can make decisions with incomplete information.
  • You're based in San Francisco and want to work together in person.

Experience with early-stage products, desktop software, developer tools or AI agents is useful.

Why Screenpipe

This is a chance to shape how people use AI with the context of their actual work. You'll have direct access to users, a public codebase to learn from, and room to carry an idea from discovery through to a working product.

Benefits

  • Health and recovery: Personal health coach or trainer, gym membership, sauna and cold plunge access, and unlimited massages.
  • Health insurance: Top-tier health insurance.
  • Flexibility: San Francisco is our home base, with flexibility to work remotely from time to time, including trips abroad such as Thailand.
  • Learning: Unlimited books and audiobooks, on us.
  • AI tools: $20,000 per month in AI tokens to build, experiment, and do your best work.
  • Personal growth: Career and life coaching.
  • Team travel: Team trips and work retreats, including places like Hawaii.

Compensation

Base salary: $160,000 to $220,000 per year. Equity range: 0.25% to 1.00% on a fully diluted basis. Final compensation depends on experience and role scope. Any equity grant is subject to board approval, equity plan terms, vesting and definitive documents.

This role is full-time and in person in San Francisco. We are not offering visa sponsorship for this role.

Apply

Send us a product you helped build and a short explanation of your contribution. Include one example of a customer insight that changed what you shipped. Please use public examples or anonymize confidential details.

Explore Screenpipe and the codebase, then apply through YC.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
About Us

Axle Health builds AI scheduling and workforce management software to empower in-home healthcare providers to deliver exceptional, personalized care right where patients feel most comfortable—at home.

Some of the biggest providers in the country use our software (like Cityblock Health and U Penn Health System) to improve the utilization of their field teams by 17%+, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching.

Our platform includes proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, a mobile app for field staff, an operations dashboard for office teams, engagement and booking tools for patients, and a wide range of integrations and external APIs for modular access.

We’re a team of top-tier engineers and operators, backed by $14m from top investors such as Y Combinator, Pear VC, and F-Prime, applying our intellect and logistics experience to upend how home healthcare is delivered.

About You

Axle Health is building the operating system for home healthcare - scheduling, route optimization, and patient engagement tools that give health systems and home-based care providers the infrastructure to run better, faster, and at greater scale. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own critical product initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and GTM teams to ship features that meaningfully improve how clinicians deliver care and how operations teams run the day-to-day. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product, where you'll have significant autonomy to shape what we build and how.

The Senior Product Manager who thrives here isn't waiting for a fully-scoped customer request to land in their lap. You have genuine product taste. You can look at a workflow and see immediately where the friction is, articulate what a great experience should feel like for home healthcare providers , and champion that standard all the way through to launch. You're a true advocate for the customer and the user - someone who leans into the user experience and holds the bar on experience even when it's easier to ship something just good enough. You're equally comfortable digging into the data and riding along with our customers to understand what they actually need.

You've shipped B2B vertical SaaS products at early-stage startups and know what it takes to move fast with limited resources, make smart trade-offs without losing sight of the user, and build things people actually want to use.

We do not monitor YC applications, please apply directly on our website to be considered for this position: https://www.axlehealth.com/careers

What You'll Do

  • Product Ownership: Own strategy and execution for key features within our scheduling, route optimization, and patient engagement platforms - from discovery through launch and iteration
  • UX and Experience Advocacy: Champion our customer’s experience in every product decision - articulate what "great" looks and feels like from a user's perspective, and hold that bar through design, engineering, and launch
  • Engineering Partnership: Work iteratively with engineering teams to scope features, make intelligent trade-offs, and accelerate delivery of high-impact roadmap initiatives
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with our sales, delivery and account management teams to understand operational workflows, gather requirements from home healthcare providers, and ensure solutions fit seamlessly into clinical operations
  • User Research: Develop deep empathy for clinicians and patients through direct user research, ride-alongs, and continuous feedback loops

jobs.desc:
NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead Trust Services programs for DGX Cloud. DGX Cloud powers large-scale AI infrastructure across NVIDIA, cloud service providers, and NVIDIA Cloud Partners, making trust, integrity, and operational resilience critical to customer success. This role will drive the program structure needed to ensure we are running our infrastructure in known-good configurations across firmware, platform, and runtime environments. The work sits at the intersection of trust services, infrastructure security, product security, compliance, engineering execution, and partner readiness. This is a highly cross-functional role focused on turning trust and security requirements into clear roadmaps and execution plans..

Lead Trust Services programs across DGXCloud, including program charter, PLC execution, roadmap, achievements, risks, and cross-functional alignment.

Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, DevOps, CSPs, and NCPs to establish and implement trust service standards across firmware, platform, and software teams.

Establish program structure through Jira, Confluence, roadmap artifacts, operating rhythms, dashboards, and governance reviews.

Coordinate development and rollout plans across partners and customers, ensuring clear signals that services are operating in a known-good state.

Build executive-ready updates, risk summaries, and decision materials that clarify scope, ownership, progress, blockers, and customer impact.

12+ years of technical program management experience driving complex infrastructure, trust services, security, compliance, or software engineering programs in fast-paced environments.

Proven success leading cross-functional trust, security, risk, compliance, or platform programs across cloud IaaS, SaaS, distributed systems, or infrastructure engineering.

Strong understanding of infrastructure trust and security concepts such as attestation, firmware/platform integrity, access control, vulnerability management, patching, and secrets management.

Experience driving programs through formal product or software lifecycle processes, including scope definition, requirements, roadmap planning, execution tracking, and release readiness.

Ability to bring together Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, and partner teams around shared requirements, ownership, key achievements, and measurable outcomes.

Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, dashboards, and program artifacts used to manage execution, governance, and audit readiness.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical and compliance topics for senior collaborators.

MS in EE, CS, or related technical field, or equivalent experience.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

Experience with GPU infrastructure, confidential computing, device trust, firmware security, or hardware/software trust models.

Working knowledge of major cloud platforms.

Experience using automation, telemetry, and dashboards to improve compliance operations and trust posture.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I, Expert Apply
Staff Product Manager, Student Experience
jobs.desc:
About Stepful :

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our values :

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

  • Care first : We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

  • Learn quickly : We test, learn with data, and iterate.

  • Build together : We win when we rely on each other.

  • Own it : We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The opportunity:

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Management and partners closely with the Student Experience team, including student success coaches, instructors, and career services, as well as design, engineering, data, and marketing.

This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our NYC office, requiring three days/week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in office.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end student experience for both our D2C and B2B2C business, from onboarding and live instruction through graduation.

  • Challenge long-held assumptions about how students learn and progress, and bring bold, evidence-backed ideas for improving completion, certification pass rates, and job outcomes.

  • Partner closely with the Student Experience team to understand where students get stuck, and decide what should be solved with product, with process, or with people.

  • Talk to students regularly through interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops so their real needs shape what we build.

  • Run a disciplined experimentation program with A/B tests and rapid prototypes to learn quickly and scale what works.

  • Collaborate with designers and engineers to ship intuitive, mobile-friendly experiences for learners who are often studying on the go.

jobs.desc: Full-Time | Healthcare in the U.S. is a mess, and most of the data that could help is locked in places nobody can use. Komodo has mapped the patient journey across the country: diagnoses, treatments, providers, payers. Our customers are pharma companies, payers and health systems that want to act on that picture. We're building the platform that puts it in their hands. There's an AI analyst that works across the whole map. There are apps that turn a population described in plain English into a full report in seconds, and tools that let analysts open, check and rerun the code behind every answer. Underneath all of it is a single query engine that every app and agent shares, so a new product is weeks of work instead of quarters. Building has gotten cheap. Deciding what to build is the hard part now, and that's the job. We want product managers who: • Have shipped data, analytics or developer products that people use every day • Prototype things themselves with AI coding tools, and would rather show a working version than write a spec • Can sit with a customer, find the problem underneath the request, and say no to the rest • Write clearly and briefly Healthcare experience helps, but it isn't required. Curiosity about how the system actually works is. Small team, real customers, and more leverage per person than I've seen anywhere. If that sounds like you, email our head of product at kaushal.parikh@komodohealth.com Or me at ramraj.velmurugan@komodohealth.com Please include the keyword from my HN profile in the subject of the email!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager · Senior Electrical & Firmware Engineer
jobs.desc: Full-time | We're the studio behind the artist BREAKFAST. We design and build his robotic sculptures for the Venice Biennale, Rockefeller Center, the Fontainebleau in Las Vegas, Tiffany & Co. in New York, Dubai and Seoul, and private collections around the world. The largest is the world's largest kinetic sculpture: 53 feet wide, nearly 3,000 motorized tiles driven by live wind and tide data, aboard a Royal Caribbean cruise ship. No screens, no projectors. Each piece is hundreds to thousands of motors on an RS-485 bus under a Linux host, built to run for a decade with nobody watching it, and every board, line of firmware and bracket is designed and built by 17 people in our Brooklyn studio. See them move: https://theartistbreakfast.com/works Senior Technical Program Manager: the artist's person on the ground with a six-person senior design and engineering team. You own every schedule in Asana, pressure-test estimates, run the weekly rhythm, flag slips the day you know, and deal with clients through install. Hardware+software TPM or producer background (robotics, consumer hardware, instruments), 8–12 years, fluent across at least two of mech/EE/firmware/software/ID. $150–200k base + profit share. Senior Electrical & Firmware Engineer: own the electronics end to end. KiCad schematic→layout→revision, stepper/BLDC drive tuning, RS-485/Ethernet bus architecture, embedded C, production test fixtures, field-failure analysis. 10+ years shipping electronics you personally owned; real motor control; power/EMI/thermal; prototype→CM. $140–200k base + profit share. No art background needed. We care whether you're sharp, can own a thing alone, and write plainly. Apply at https://theartistbreakfast.com/jobs and mention HN. The "what makes you right for this" box is the part we read.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Customer Engagement & Experience
Group Product Manager – Corporate Systems
jobs.desc:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture.  Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Corporate Systems Product Management focuses on the internal platforms that power how Smartsheet operates - including Finance, People, Sales and Entitlements, Billing and Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation. Product Managers in this team steward product strategy, roadmaps, business workflows, and long-term platform evolution across these domains, partnering closely with Engineering and business stakeholders to translate complex enterprise needs into scalable technology outcomes.

As Group Product Manager – Corporate Systems, you will lead the Product Management function across Corporate Systems, managing and developing a team of Product Managers responsible for some of Smartsheet’s most critical internal technology domains. You will establish a cohesive product strategy across the portfolio, ensuring domain roadmaps connect to company priorities while identifying dependencies and opportunities that span traditional organizational and system boundaries.

You will operate at both the strategic and execution levels: coaching Product Managers to develop strong product practices, partnering with Engineering leadership on portfolio strategy and investment decisions, and directly engaging in the most complex cross-functional initiatives. You will help evolve Corporate Systems from a collection of enterprise applications and projects into a product-led portfolio of platforms, capabilities, data, integrations, and employee experiences designed for long-term scale.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Engineering leadership and senior stakeholders across Finance, People & Culture, Sales/GTM, Product Engineering, Data, Security, and other business functions.

You Will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for Financial Systems, People Systems, Sales & Entitlements, Billing & Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation
  • Define and evolve the product-management operating model for Corporate Systems, establishing consistent practices for product discovery, customer problem definition, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, metrics, and lifecycle management
  • Establish a cohesive portfolio strategy that connects individual product domains to Corporate Systems and company-level objectives
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to align product and technical strategy, ensuring investments balance new capabilities with platform health, reliability, scalability, security, technical debt, and operational sustainability
  • Drive portfolio-level prioritization and investment decisions across competing business needs, helping teams focus capacity on the highest-value problems and outcomes
  • Identify and manage dependencies

We're the studio behind the artist BREAKFAST. jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing Manager - Novus
jobs.desc:
The Team + The Role

Software is being written faster than ever, and AI coding agents are accelerating how teams build and ship. Novus is Pendo's answer to what happens after software ships: helping fast-moving teams understand what is actually happening in their products and where to focus next. This is a new product, in a new category, for an audience Pendo has not traditionally sold to before: product engineers and application owners building AI-native software.

As Lead Product Marketing Manager for Novus, you are the marketing lead and GTM owner for the product. You own the narrative, positioning, demand strategy, community presence, launch moments, and early commercial outcomes end to end. This is a 0-to-1 role for someone who can write the playbook, execute it hands-on, and drive clarity across product, sales, marketing, and leadership.

This is a remote role in the US. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Narrative and positioning: Own the messaging, positioning, and talk tracks for Novus, including the breakthrough narrative, category story, and positioning documentation. Keep product, sales, marketing, and leadership aligned as the product and market evolve.
  • End-to-end GTM ownership: Build and run the full go-to-market plan across audience targeting, channel strategy, campaign strategy, sales readiness, launch moments, and success metrics. Own the outcomes rather than handing strategy off to another team.
  • Top-of-funnel and conversion: Partner with revenue marketing to define the acquisition channel mix, run campaigns, and drive early-access signups. Connect demand activity to free-to-paid conversion and early commercial signals.
  • Community building: Build Novus' presence where builders already spend time, including developer forums, social channels, influencer relationships, and event-driven activation. Earn trust with audiences that are skeptical of traditional marketing.
  • PLG motion: Partner with product and growth to design self-serve onboarding, activation flows, and freemium-to-paid conversion paths. Use data and feedback to improve how users discover, try, activate, and expand with Novus.
  • Novus and Pendo positioning: Define how Novus and Pendo exist together in the market. Shape the path for customers moving from fast-moving AI-native teams into more complex product organizations.
  • Sales and partner enablement: Build the materials, messaging, and proof points that help sales and partner teams have credible conversations with product engineers. Translate the product for a buyer that is meaningfully different from Pendo's traditional PM audience.
  • Metrics and commercial impact: Work with revenue marketing to define and track the metrics that connect Novus activity to pipeline and early revenue outcomes. Focus on activation, free-to-paid conversion, marketing-sourced ARR, and other signals that show whether the motion is working.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Product Marketing Directors don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everyth

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview 

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in driving commercialization of Amwell’s solutions. This role focuses on executing high-impact go-to-market initiatives, enabling enterprise sales teams, supporting strategic deals and RFP responses, and translating complex product capabilities into differentiated, outcome-driven messaging.

This role is ideal for an experienced product marketer who can operate independently, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and partner closely with Product, Sales, and Marketing leaders to deliver measurable commercial impact.

Core Responsibilities 

Commercial Leadership

· Develop and refine platform positioning that differentiates solutions in the payer market

· Define go-to-market strategy including target segments, launch sequencing, and success metrics

· Coordinate cross-functional launch activities across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success

· Lead execution of go-to-market initiatives for new products, capabilities, and market expansions within the payer segment

· Develop thought leadership for payer market trends

· Partner with Product and Commercial leadership on pricing and packaging strategy to support scalable commercialization.

 

Sales, RFP & Field Enablement

· Develop launch messaging, sales tools, and enablement materials aligned with established positioning

· Partner with Sales and proposal teams to support RFP responses with differentiated messaging and positioning

· Develop executive-ready materials for strategic opportunities and client presentations

· Maintain reusable messaging frameworks that accelerate RFP response development

· Develop payer-facing sales materials and supporting resources that help health plan clients communicate program value to their employer group customers

· Incorporate field feedback to continuously improve sales tools and messaging

· Track and analyze launch and enablement performance to continuously improve commercialization outcomes.

 

Messaging & Competitive Intelligence

· Translate complex product and clinical capabilities into clear, outcome-driven messaging

· Maintain and evolve competitive battlecards and positioning guidance

· Monitor payer and digital health market trends and synthesize insights that inform messaging and field enablement

· Cross-Functional Collaboration

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity 

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Oportun’s flagship, AI-powered Savings product. Savings is an important driver of member growth and retention, giving this role significant influence over the future of our financial health platform and how we help members build stronger financial futures.

You’ll lead the ideation, development, launch, and scaling of new products and features while partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support. This role reports to the Vice President & General Manager for Savings and Mobile. Candidates located in Central or Eastern time zones are strongly preferred to support team and stakeholder collaboration.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

jobs.desc:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

We are looking for a Senior Principal Product Manager to define the future of Twin's member experience. In this role, you will shape how members engage with Twin across app, chat, voice, and proactive AI experiences. What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

Senior Product Manager, Endpoint
Halcyon | Product | Remote, United States | Travel: 30–40%

About Halcyon

Halcyon builds an advanced anti-ransomware platform that enterprise security teams rely on to stop attacks other tools miss. Our agent runs on our customers endpoints, in production, in some of the largest environments in the world. We move quickly and give people real ownership, which only works because we're deliberate about who we bring on

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our endpoint product area. You will own a meaningful piece of the business: shaping strategy for your area, driving it from problem definition through GA and iteration, and being accountable for the results. You will have a strong voice in where the endpoint product goes, and you will own the tradeoffs that get it there.

Our engineering team is highly technical, and you will work with them daily. Engineering owns the solution design, but you will own the customer outcomes and business objectives. You need to hold your own in those conversations, ask the right questions, and understand why endpoint is its own discipline.

This is a customer-facing role. You will spend real time with enterprise security teams in roadmap reviews, executive briefings, and technical deep dives. You will also work closely with our Sales Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and Support, who are in front of customers every day and are one of your best sources of signal. Understanding your audience will be key success factor, and you will need to know when to lean into technical aspects but also be able to articulate the value that the technical solutions provide to executive level buyers.

What You'll Own:

The endpoint product area

  • Shape the strategy for our endpoint solution and translate company objectives into a roadmap you can defend.
  • Define scope, sequence the work, and make the tradeoff calls. Own them when they are questioned and adjust when needed.
  • Drive initiatives from discovery through general availability and post-launch iteration through a transparent and collaborative approach.
  • Report on outcomes: adoption, retention, deal impact. Shipping is not the finish line.

Customer engagement

  • Meet directly with enterprise customers and prospects to validate problems before you commit to solutions.
  • Represent the product in roadmap reviews, executive briefings, and technical deep dives with security teams.
  • Turn scattered feedback into a defensible point of view, not a wish list.

Cross-functional execution

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

Core Values

  • Authenticity — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.
  • Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.
  • Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.
  • Humility — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".
  • Happiness — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role

Digible is hiring a Senior Product Manager to found a brand-new pod at the center of our 2026 strategy: productizing Digible's agency operations and customer data, and serving as the connective tissue that turns a collection of services and tools into one coherent experience for our agency team and ultimately our customers.

You'll define the pod's charter and roadmap from scratch, partnering deeply with our agency operations leaders (your day-one allies and internal customers) to decide what gets solved by people, product, or automation. You'll ship experiences that make Digible dramatically more efficient internally and noticeably better to buy from and work with externally.

This is also our most technical PM seat: you'll work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization — and you should be excited by exactly that kind of work. As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering. This is a role for someone who loves hands-on IC work. For the right person, it can also open a path into product management leadership as our org scales. You'll report to the VP of Product.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to move faster and more effectively than a team our size normally could.

You'll Love This Job If You Love:

Products with…

  • 🧵 Connective Tissue: unifying fragmented tools and services into one coherent customer experience
  • 🏢 Internal Customers: internal agency teams as primary users today — evolving toward serving customers directly over time
  • ✨ AI: deciding what gets solved by people, product

jobs.desc:
Head of Product | Contract, 20 hrs/week to start, growing into full-time | Remote (US overlapping hours) | Reports to the CEO

The short version

Koast is the AI operating layer for teams that run Meta ads at volume. Agencies, in-house media buying teams, and enterprise buyers managing 10+ ad accounts and launching 50+ ads a week use Koast to launch faster, automate optimizations off real attribution data, and see every account from one hub. The Koast Agent is the next layer: an AI that reads the account, spots what matters, and acts inside guardrails.

We are a small team shipping fast. The product is live, customers are paying, a Whop partnership just onboarded a wave of new users, and the Agent build is underway. What we do not have is one person who owns the product end to end: what gets built, why, in what order, and whether it actually landed.

That is this role. It starts at 20 hours a week on contract. If you are the right person, it becomes the full-time product seat at Koast.

What you will own

Discovery that finds the real problem. You will sit in on enterprise sales calls and onboarding sessions, run discovery with agencies and media buying teams, and figure out what they are actually trying to get done versus what they say they want. Every feature request gets mapped to a job: launching smoother, getting their team in, getting tasks done, keeping users active and growing spend inside Koast. If it does not serve a job, it does not get built.

Specs that engineering can execute without a meeting. We run a lean engineering team plus an AI-assisted dev pipeline. That only works when the ticket is unambiguous. You will write PRDs and Shortcut tickets that define the behavior, the edge cases, the data dependencies (Meta API limits, Hyros and Cometly attribution feeds, Whop account provisioning), and the acceptance criteria. If an engineer or an agent has to guess, the spec was not done.

The queue, and what is missing from it. You own the Up Next column. You will keep engineering fed so they are never blocked, and you will keep a standing view of what is discussed in Slack, support, and QA that does not yet have a ticket. Gaps are your problem before they become customer problems.

Evidence over opinion. PostHog, Intercom, session replays, rage clicks, support threads. You will run the user-behavior audit, know where people drop off in launching, and bring numbers to every prioritization argument, including the ones with the CEO.

Delivery from spec to shipped. Governance, milestones, release notes, and the customer conversation after it ships. When something breaks or slips, you are the one who says so early, not the one who explains it after.

Technical judgement in a non-deterministic product. The Koast Agent makes decisions off data that is noisy, seasonal, and shaped by Meta's learning phase. You will make product calls that respect that: what the Agent is allowed to do, what it must never do, how we measure whether an automated action was correct. Guardrails are infrastructure here, not UI. You need to understand why.

What you will do week to week

  • Run discovery sessions with prospects and customers and turn them into scoped, execution-ready PRDs.
  • Surface technical risk early: undocumented API behavior, missing data, an assumption that will not survive a real ad account.
  • Write and groom Shortcut tickets with enough detail for an engineer or Claude Code to ship without a follow-up question.
  • Partner with engineering on feasibility, sequencing, and cutting scope to what ships this week.
  • Own success metrics per feature and report on them after launch, n
