jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.desc:
🌎 The Opportunity

In the next 30 years, the world will transform every part of the built environment to be climate positive green infrastructure. But today’s renewable energy development process can’t move fast enough to meet global goals. Paces exists to change that. We are providing software and services to accelerate power development - unlocking one of the greatest opportunities of our time: transforming how infrastructure gets built and ensuring it’s built with renewable energy.

🛠️ Our Solution

Paces is building the development engine for renewable infrastructure and power projects. We have built Agentic AI that automates early-stage due diligence and pairs it with in-house expertise to accelerate late-stage diligence. The result: projects move from siting to construction-ready in a fraction of the time. Our platform streamlines siting, interconnection, and permitting for renewable energy and data center developers, real estate firms, EV charging companies, and more.

🧑‍🎨 Our Team

We are building a team where people can proudly say their time at Paces is the most impactful, meaningful work of their career. Our amazing team in Brooklyn, New York includes incredible team members from tech companies like Meta AI, DeepMind, and Tesla; various high growth startups; as well as industry leaders from TotalEnergies, Con Edison and GE.

Paces is hiring our first VP of Product , reporting to our CEO and Co-Founder. This is a hands-on leadership role : you will own product strategy across our three pods (Power, Risk, and Platform), build and lead the product org, and stay close enough to the work to write the spec, sit on the customer call, and make the hard calls on the details yourself.

🏆 What You’ll Achieve

  • Product Strategy : Own the roadmap for a platform that carries a data center or power project from market selection through siting, permitting, and interconnection. 
  • Metrics driven : Understand the metrics that AI forward products work, and build a product customers reach for daily rather than quarterly.
  • Org Management : Hire and coach PMs who can hold their own with a transmission engineer and a staff ML engineer in the same meeting.
  • Customer Depth : Spend real time with hyperscalers, data center developers, IPPs, and renewable developers. Turn what you hear into a roadmap engineering can build against without a translation layer.
  • AI Product Craft : Ship agentic products that domain experts trust. Set the standard for how we evaluate agent quality, handle failure modes, and decide where a human belongs in the loop.

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

As the Director of Product Marketing at Storyblok, We're looking for a Product Marketing Director to shape how we position, launch, and grow our product in the market- particularly in the US, UK and EMEA. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives. You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth.

You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership.

Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction.

What you’ll bring:

You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand. You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches. This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive. 

You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Product Positioning & Messaging

  • Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against
  • Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current
  • Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey
  • Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst

Gordian is the leader in Building Intelligence™ solutions, providing unrivaled data, robust software, and expert services to optimize every stage of the building lifecycle. From early-stage facility planning and capital budgeting to construction procurement and project delivery, Gordian empowers public sector, higher education, healthcare, and enterprise leaders to make data-driven decisions and manage their physical assets effectively.

Position Summary

Gordian is seeking an exceptional, vision-driven, and commercially minded Senior Director of Product Management to lead one of our most strategic, high-growth product portfolios: Procurement.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), you will own the end-to-end product strategy, vision, execution, and lifecycle management across our industry-leading Construction Procurement platforms (including Job Order Contracting / ezIQC® solutions and contractor workflow software).

In this high-impact executive role, you will lead a team of Product Managers & Product Owners, bridge the gap between capital planning and downstream construction procurement on the Gordian Cloud Platform, and drive sustainable SaaS and data-driven revenue growth.

  • Drive portfolio convergence—enabling seamless data and workflow integration between early-stage facility planning/FCAs, RSMeans™ cost data, and downstream procurement workflows on the Gordian Cloud Platform.
  • Balance modernizing legacy platforms with building innovative, scalable cloud capabilities and AI-enabled workflows.
2. Team Leadership & Talent Development
  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of Product Managers and Product Owners across both product lines.
  • Define clear KPIs and outcome-oriented frameworks for product teams, fostering a culture of ownership, customer empathy, speed, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX/UI, Data Science, and Revenue Operations to build a world-class product operating model.
3. Product Execution & FBS (Fortive Business System)
  • Apply Fortive Business System (FBS) tools—including Voice of Customer (VOC), Breakthrough Planning, Kaizen events, and visual management—to accelerate product velocity and quality.
  • Translate market opportunities into actionable, prioritized backlogs and quantitative business cases (ROI, market size, customer acquisition cost, retention metrics).
  • Establish strict performance tracking across SaaS metrics, customer retention, feature adoption, and margin expansion.
4. Commercial & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Partner closely with Executive Leadership, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations to ensure product roadmaps align with go-to-market strategies and overall business targets.
  • Serve as an internal and external evangelist for Gordian’s Procurem

jobs.title: Product Manager, Mail-In Blood Testing
jobs.desc:
About SiPhox Health

SiPhox Health is building the leading home testing platform for biomarkers across inflammation, hormones, and metabolic and cardiovascular health. Six in ten Americans live with a chronic disease, and our mission is to make early detection possible from home.

We operate two business lines, both scaling quickly:

  1. Mail-in blood testing: Growing more than 50% quarter over quarter, and the most comprehensive and highly rated at-home blood testing available today.
  2. At-home blood testing device: Planned launch in 2027. Our chip-based module combines biochemistry with integrated photonics, electronics, and microfluidics, protected by more than 50 patents.

SiPhox is an MIT startup backed by Tier I investors including Y Combinator, Khosla Ventures, and Intel Capital.

The Role

This is not a product-maintenance role. It is a role defined by urgency, ownership, and consequence.

We build and deliver a physical product to customers' homes. It is filled with their blood, processed by laboratories under regulatory scrutiny, and returned as a result on which they will base real health decisions.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the full product lifecycle, execution and quality, who moves decisively under pressure, and who is willing to implement a practical solution now rather than wait for a perfect one later. Candidates who require a fully mature organization, established handoffs, and a documented procedure for every situation will not find that here. The ideal candidate is prepared to build those systems while the operation runs at full speed.Areas of Ownership

Product ownership, mail-in blood testing

The product is both the physical kit and the digital results experience. You own both.

  • Own the product end to end: kit design, sample collection, return logistics, lab processing, results delivery
  • Own the digital results experience, portal and app, as a core surface, not a SW hand-off
  • Own design, build quality, cost, and customer experience across kit and software
  • Execute launches and modifications with clinical, operations, and SW development
  • Deliver new kit variants for e-commerce and B2B channels, drive continuous improvement

Product strategy and GTM, mail-in blood testing

  • Own the product roadmap
  • Run continuous customer development and drive product-market-fit improvements
  • Partner with e-commerce and B2B teams to optimize GTM and find new channels

Retention and Retention

  • Identify churn reasons; improve retention with targeted, cross-functional initiatives
  • Guarantee results are accurate and delivered on time; this standard is non-negotiable
  • Ensure products and processes meet CLIA/CAP, HIPAA, and FDA / laboratory-developed-test requirements
  • Move fast within those regulatory guardrails, not around them

Process and Metrics

  • Track sample success / redraw rate, and other drivers of delay, cost, and churn
  • Own it as a product problem: collection device, instructions, packaging
  • Track activation / completion rate: ordered, sample returned, result delivered
  • Continuously identify and eliminate bottlenecks to improve efficiency and scalability

Vendors and Partners

  • Co-own manufacturing and lab relationships; hold partners to commitments and replace them when they fall short
  • Initiate new partnerships to expand the testing menu and customer experience

Team and Collaboration

  • Develop the support team through training, feedback, and clear guidance
  • Collaborate across marketing, operations, R

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
About David AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we've brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We're looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

About our Technical Product Manager team

Our Technical Product Manager team builds the Data Factory at David AI. We set the strategy for how raw audio becomes high-quality training data, decide what gets built, and own the outcomes: scale, quality, cost, and the experience of our contributors. Working across Operations, Engineering, and Research, we move fluidly across all three to solve some of the most challenging problems at David AI.

About this role

David AI is hiring a Technical Product Manager to own a core part of our Data Factory, from early prototypes through production scale. Depending on your background and where we need you most, that could cover our contributor marketplace, our Operations infrastructure, a new or scaling business unit, or the systems our ML team relies on. You'll need the operational chops to lead complex efforts, the instinct to automate them, the technical ability to build the first MVP yourself, and the judgment to partner with engineering and research to implement at scale.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager

What excites you

  • You want to be early. You like being close to the product, the customer, and the messiness of figuring things out.

  • You enjoy turning sharp customer insight into positioning that actually changes behavior.

  • You care about story-telling. You want to build narratives from launches and words to be thoughtful and useful, not generic or AI slop.

  • You’re energized by hospitality. Hotels are complex, human, and operationally intense. That makes the work interesting, particularly in an age of AI.

  • You want real ownership. If something ships poorly, you fix it. If something lands well, you know exactly why.

What excites us

  • You’ve spent 5–7 years in product marketing at a high-growth company, ideally B2B SaaS or complex marketplaces.

  • You can explain technical or operational products in a way that feels simple and grounded. You’ve owned messaging and positioning end to end in close partnership with product, sales, and leadership. You’ve rewritten it when it didn’t work.

  • You’ve led go-to-market for real products, not just features. You know how to scope a launch, make tradeoffs, and ship. You care to measure impact post-launch.

  • You’re not precious about what “typical” PMMs look like. You like wearing different hats and can go beyond product marketing to engage contractors for events planning, or work with an agency to test some ads, when needed.

  • You’re comfortable going deep. Customer calls, sales calls, demos, win-loss. You look for signal, not anecdotes.

  • You’re hands-on. You write the first draft. You build the deck. You partner with design, but you don’t wait on them.

  • Bonus if you’ve worked in hospitality, travel, fintech, or vertical SaaS. Bigger bonus if you genuinely like hotels.

Working at Folio

  • We're a remote-first company. Three times a year, we travel to work together in-person and stay with one of our hotel partners.

  • We love experimenting with new tools. For the most part, we rely on Google Meet, Linear, Notion, and Slack to make decisions and get things done day-to-day.

  • You will have the opportunity to travel frequently and meet our customers in person at conferences and events, which you will be helping plan for.

  • We're a small team who work collaboratively and meet daily for stand up

What we value

  • Craft. We take pride in our work, find joy in execution, and believe that the best companies are built at a steady yet resilient pace.

  • Optimism. We believe in ourselves and each other and know anything is possible with the right amount of hustle and grit.

  • Ownership. We love making things better and have a strong sense of shared responsibility over everything we create together.

  • Hospitality. The industry we’re building for has a culture of service to others, and we bring that energy to how we work together each day.

ABOUT HITPAY

================================================================================

HitPay is the payments and business operations platform for small and medium

merchants across Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Australia and

single API.

Payments is a regulated business. We hold a Major Payment Institution licence

from the Monetary Authority of Singapore and operate under a spread of local

regimes, scheme rules and partner-bank obligations. Today, most of our risk,

fraud and AML capability exists to keep us safe. We believe a meaningful share

of it should also be a product our merchants pay for.

That is the job.

================================================================================

THE ROLE

================================================================================

You will own risk, fraud and compliance as a product line — not as a cost

centre. You are being hired to design, build and ship products that reduce loss,

shorten onboarding, and generate revenue: fraud screening our merchants opt into,

chargeback and dispute tooling they will pay for, underwriting and KYB

capabilities we can sell or embed, monitoring and reporting our larger merchants

and platform partners need in order to grow on us.

This is a builder's role with a regulator's discipline. You will spend your week

between a compliance officer, a backend engineer and a merchant, and you will be

the person who can hold all three conversations without a translator.

================================================================================

Revenue products

  • Define, price and ship monetisable risk and fraud products: fraud scoring

    and screening tiers, chargeback protection and representment tooling,

    dispute automation, merchant-facing risk dashboards, KYB / identity

    verification as a paid capability, and risk services for platform and

    marketplace partners.

  • Build the commercial case: attach rate, pricing model, loss economics,

    payback. Own the P&L logic of what you ship, not just the roadmap.

  • Work with Sales and Partnerships to take these products to market — you will

    be in customer calls, and you will lose some of them and learn why.

Compliance and risk engineering

  • Own the product surface of transaction monitoring, sanctions and PEP

    yours to move.

    screening providers, device intelligence, identity — including build vs.

    buy calls and commercial negotiation support.

  • Be the trusted counterpart to the Compliance and MLRO function. You will not

jobs.title: 1st Product Manager
jobs.desc:
The company

Ooak Data turns company data into training data for AI agents.

Frontier labs can train models to reason. They cannot train them to work: navigating a real company's Slack threads, half-finished Notion docs, contradictory Jira tickets, and permission boundaries. That requires real enterprise data, and you cannot synthesize it. You have to source it.

We plug into enterprise tools, anonymize everything into a structurally identical digital twin, and generate reinforcement-learning environments with expert-level tasks calibrated against frontier models.

We are a Y Combinator company with 7 figures signed contracts with three frontier AI labs, and we are scaling delivery aggressively over the next twelve months. Three founders, full-time since December 2025: Pierre-Louis (CEO, ex-COO in edtech, sold data to frontier labs), Grégoire (CPO, first PM & head of Ops at Epsor through Series B), Thomas (CTO, ex-Head of Data at PayLead, ex-Samsung AI lab).

Why this role exists

Our engineering team ships faster than founders can specify. We have four product surfaces, most of them internal, all of them technical, and every one of them decides whether an environment ships this week or next.

We are hiring our first Product Manager to own the product: what gets built, in what order, and whether it actually made us faster.

What you will own

The full chain, from the moment a CEO agrees to share their data to the moment a frontier lab receives an environment.

Partner experience

  • The Data Hub, onboarding and export tutorials a CEO sees when they hand us their company's history. Trust and speed at the top of the funnel.

The data pipeline

  • Connectors, ingestion and anonymisation. How raw Slack, Drive, mail and CRM exports become a clean digital twin. You will spend a lot of time with Thomas (CTO) here.

Pharos, our delivery platform

  • The internal tool our Ops team lives in to run QA and delivery. Throughput is the metric. This is where 3 env a week becomes 10.

RL environments

  • The thing the labs buy. Task design, calibration, what separates a dataset from a real agent training ground.

You will run two kinds of work at once: short projects that need tight coordination across Tech, Ops and GTM this week, and long ones where nothing exists yet and you get to decide what should.

Who you are

  • A doer. You know the product methodologies and you use them when they help, not by the book. Your instinct when something is slow is to fix it, not to schedule a workshop about it.
  • AI-pilled. You vibe code. You prototype before you write a spec. You design your own mockups. You are curious about how the models themselves are built and trained.
  • UX taste, ROI brain. Our workflows have to be brutally efficient. You judge a piece of software or a workflow by efficient it allows us to be or what value it brings to our customers.
  • You keep pace. Our engineers ship a lot. You turn that into something coherent rather than slowing it down.
  • 7+ years in product, at least some of it technical: data, infra, ML, developer tools or ops platforms. Founders and first PMs who built the function from nothing are very welcome.
  • Fluent French and English. Our customers are American, our data partners spread worldwide, our team speaks both.
  • Based in Paris.

The extra that make the difference

  • A research streak: you read papers, you have opinions on RL, you have trained or fine-tuned something.

Terms

  • Compensation: €70-90k + bonus, and 0.2% to 0.5%

Pasito is the AI workspace for employee benefits.

We’re rethinking how group insurance and benefits are underwritten, delivered, used and measured - by the people who design them and the people who depend on them. We don’t build for brokers, carriers and employers - we build with them. That collaboration shows up in everything we ship: AI agents that extract and structure plan data, tools that turn complexity into clarity for employees, and workflows that save carriers and consultants hundreds of hours per case.

Today, Pasito supports many of the largest insurance carriers and brokers in the U.S. We’re backed by Y Combinator and Core Innovation Capital, and we’re growing quickly. We ship fast, iterate relentlessly, and care deeply about building systems that are accurate, scalable, and human.

If you’re excited to work alongside exceptional operators and engineers, and apply AI in a legacy industry where precision and trust matter, Pasito is the place for you.

We’re hiring a Product Owner to own and drive the development of key products at Pasito, including our broker and carrier enrollment workbench and AI Extractions and plan processing products.

Own communication and rollout

Enable internal teams

  • Act as the internal expert for your product areas

AI Product Operations Lead
jobs.desc:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands

About the team

Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.

AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.

The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.

About the role

We're looking for an AI Product Operations Lead to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&D.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. You'll help us identify the highest-value problems AI can solve, understand how people work today, design the right solution, build or coordinate its delivery, and then stay accountable for how it performs after launch.

One day, you might be working with a team to understand a frustrating workflow and deciding whether a simple prompt, automation, integration, agent, or internal app is the right answer. The next, you could be improving an existing AI workflow, testing its reliability, helping coordinate access to an enterprise AI tool, or working with IT and InfoSec to make sure a new solution can scale responsibly.

You'll own the connective layer between AI strategy and day-to-day execution across R&D.

This isn't a role for someone who only wants to prototype prompts, manage project plans, or write requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys combining systems thinking, AI fluency, user discovery, technical execution, and operational ownership—and who wants to see things through.

You'll report to our VP of Product Operations and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, IT, InfoSec, and other AI practitioners across Typeform.

What you'll do

  • Build and continuously improve our backlog of AI opportunities across R&D, helping teams identify, prioritize, and sequence the jobs where AI can have the greatest impact.
  • Take ambiguous problems from initial discovery through to delivery: understand the user and workflow, explore options and trade-offs, design the right system, build or coordinate implementation, test, document, launch, measure, and improve.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Payments
jobs.desc:
🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

💻 Role

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager, Payments to lead the strategy and execution of the core payments platform and experiences that underpin the Whatnot marketplace. You will own the systems that power how buyers pay, how sellers get paid, and how money moves through our ecosystem—processing billions in annual GMV across 50+ categories and enabling payouts to tens of thousands of sellers globally.

In this role, you will work across the full payments stack, from payment initiation and processing to payouts, refunds, financial data infrastructure, and incentive instruments. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Finance, Trust & Safety, Legal, CX, Operations, and other product teams to deliver capabilities that unlock growth while maintaining strong financial controls and managing risk.

You will:

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for Payments , balancing short-term wins with long-term platform investments that support extremely fast growth and international expansion.

  • Deeply understand stakeholder needs – from sellers managing their businesses to Finance teams closing monthly books to CX resolving refund disputes; and translate them into clear product strategies and scalable systems.

  • Define and own core payments metrics including authorization rates, payout success, refund rates, processing costs, and financial accuracy. Use these to guide prioritization and measure impact.

  • Drive execution across multiple workstreams , coordinating backend payments systems, payment integrations, and frontend UX while managing dependencies and timelines.

  • Build the financial data foundation the business needs, including ledger systems that power internal reporting, seller transparency and tools they need, and accurate month-end closes.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, Trust & Safety, CX, and Operations to ensure compliance, manage risk appropriately, and support efficient operations at scale.

  • Establish metrics and experimentation frameworks to validate performance, test new capabilities, and continuously improve outcomes for users and internal teams.

jobs.desc:
About HUD

HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25.

About the role

We’re looking a Product Manager to own product work for our data marketplace. You’ll make it easier for data vendors to bring high-quality RL environments and training data to HUD, and for research teams to discover, evaluate, and use them. You’ll work closely with engineering, research, and GTM to turn technical and operational needs into product decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the marketplace product lifecycle, from understanding vendor and buyer needs through prioritization, launch, and iteration

  • Improve how vendors onboard, submit work, understand quality feedback, and manage their offerings on HUD

  • Improve how research teams discover, assess, and access environments and training data that meet their needs

  • Work with engineering, research, GTM, and operations to turn complex requirements and manual processes into reliable platform workflows

  • Define and track measures of marketplace health, product adoption, and user experience; use feedback and product data to decide what to build next

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Experience owning a live software product from discovery through launch and iteration

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to simplify technically complex workflows for users

  • Experience talking directly with users, identifying the problem behind a request, and turning what you learn into clear priorities

  • Ability to balance user needs, business impact, and engineering constraints when making product decisions

  • Comfort using qualitative feedback and quantitative signals to assess whether a product change worked

  • Clear written communication and the ability to bring engineers and other partners together around decisions in an ambiguous environment

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience with marketplaces or products serving two distinct groups of users

  • Familiarity with AI training data, evaluations, and RL environments

  • Experience building a product function or establishing product practices on a growing team

  • Early-stage startup experience and strong communication skills for collaboration across teams and time zones

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.

  • Team Size : ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.desc:
Product Owner

Remote | Permanent Contractor | Core EU Collaboration Hours
Reports to: Product Manager

Are you a product driven problem solver who enjoys turning customer insight into things that actually get built? Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!

We build software that takes the stress, chaos, and friction out of managing a health practice. As our newest Product Owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in translating vision into action, turning customer needs into features and driving product outcomes that truly matter.

You’re someone on the rise - intelligent, opinionated (in the best way), and ready to make an impact. You’re not easily swayed, and you’re happy to take a stand when it serves the customer and the product. You connect dots, ask great questions, and care deeply about delivering value. If that sounds like you… read on!

You’re Excited To

  • Be the voice of the customer; advocate for user needs and pain points.

  • Maintain deep customer understanding and share insights with key teams.

  • Translate product priorities into clear, prioritised & actionable items for your team

  • Work closely with engineering to understand constraints, dependencies, and system behaviour

  • Build alignment, trust and collaborate seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Customer Support

  • Ensure continuous delivery of value; own the lifecycle from discovery to post-launch iteration.

  • Guide product decisions that make a real difference for the people using Zanda every day

  • Communicate clearly across async and real-time channels.

  • Surface risks early and drive grounded, data-informed decisions.

  • Contribute to risk-based analysis of product changes and support identification of potential vulnerabilities


What You Bring to the Team

Experience 

  • 2+ years of hands-on product ownership experience (SaaS experience an asset)

  • Proven ability to translate customer pains into clear requirements and impactful improvements

  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and product development architecture

  • Experience in another role before moving into product - a Customer Success, Support, or similar background is a real plus

  • Demonstrated experience working with remote, cross-cultural teams across multiple time zones

Skills 

  • Customer Insight & Discovery - understands user needs, pain points, and motivations.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Product Manager role, not a Full-stack role)
jobs.desc:
We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers.
Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you.
Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it".
A few notes before you apply:
- Experience: we're looking for people with a few years of hands-on product or engineering work behind them. The role is autonomous from the first week, so we need you ready to take the wheel. - Recruiting agencies: we hire in-house and manage every application ourselves, so there's no need to send candidates or reach out about partnerships. Thank you for understanding! - If your stack matches, please do reach out. Django/DRF/Celery/Postgres with React/Next, Python automation work around SEO: if that's your day-to-day and you're using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever you like) in your real workflow, I want to hear from you. Don't talk yourself out of it because the title isn't an exact fit; tell me what you've built.
Recruitment process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days.
Our ATS forces us to list specific ywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't
P.S: Not a PM, or the PM role isn't quite your thing? Have a look at everything else we have open at https://careers.searchatlas.com and apply directly to the role that suits you best (preferred route). If you're not sure which one that is, email me with a short line on what you do and I'll point you to the right one.

jobs.title: Agile Product Manager
jobs.desc:
We're looking for a Product Manager to own roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for a digital product initiative, operating within Agile/Scrum frameworks. The role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution — most engagements in this market are technical-delivery-adjacent (software, data, or AI products) rather than purely strategic, so comfort partnering closely with engineering is expected.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product backlog, prioritization, and roadmap using Agile/Scrum practices
  • Translate business and stakeholder needs into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to scope, sequence, and deliver iteratively
  • Define and track success metrics/KPIs for the product area
  • Facilitate or support Agile ceremonies (backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews) alongside a Scrum Master where applicable
  • (Common variant, ~1 in 5 postings) Own AI/Agentic feature delivery — defining how GenAI or agentic capabilities integrate into the product
  • (Common variant, ~1 in 7 postings) Operate as a Technical PM — comfortable in architecture/API-level discussions, not just business requirements
  • (Frequent industry context) CPG/enterprise data-product ownership — managing data platforms, catalogs, or analytics products feeding business stakeholders


Required Skills (Must-Have)

  • Agile Product Management — backlog ownership, iterative delivery, Scrum/Kanban fluency
  • Proven Product Manager, Product Owner, or Technical PM experience
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration (engineering, data, business)
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable product requirements


Nice to Have

  • AI/GenAI or Agentic product experience (increasingly common — nearly 1 in 5 current postings)
  • Data product management experience (catalogs, analytics platforms, BI)
  • CPG, enterprise, or regulated-industry domain experience
  • Technical fluency (APIs, data architecture) for Technical PM-flavored roles

jobs.desc:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

We’re looking for a candidate who is passionate about healthcare, and providing independent healthcare practitioners the best single solution for delivering high quality care to patients. If you nerd out on positioning and messaging, love diving deep into market research and competitive intelligence, and think any time spent talking to customers is time well spent, this is the job for you. This role serves as the nexus of knowledge for EHR and care delivery products for the private practice market.

Your Area of Focus

  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify customer needs, preferences, and trends
  • Develop product positioning, messaging, and value propositions that resonate with target audiences
  • Partner with product management to ensure that our products and services are meeting customer needs and delivering value
  • Collaborate with the sales team to develop sales enablement materials, including presentations, demos, and case studies
  • Make complex concepts easy to understand
  • Analyze and report on key metrics, including customer acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices related to product marketing and healthcare to identify trends and emerging opportunities.  
  • Deliver weekly, monthly and quarterly competitive intelligence that draws on internal and external data, research and analysis and uses the voice of our customer.

Your Professional Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in product marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS preferred. Healthcare technology and EHR experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with a proven track record in voice of the customer activities.
  • Experience developing positioning and messaging for complex products in heavily regulated and competitive markets.
  • Strong understanding of B2B and B2C marketing best practices
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
About Integrated Specialty Coverages

Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

Backed by one of the leading private equity firms, Onex Partners, and led by a forward-thinking management team, ISC is combining the worlds of insurance and technology to create an Insurtech powerhouse. As a leading online distributor of insurance products for a range of industries and “Main Street USA”, we are looking for the right people to help us in our mission of achieving exponential growth. We strive to be the number one place to go for brokers and agents to source insurance. To accomplish this, we’re building a digitally focused team that deeply understands the intersection between user experience, data, and AI/ML to optimize the way we engage with our customers and partners.

Job Summary

The Commercial Lines Product Manager (CLPM) focuses on P&C insurance lines with complex, high-touch case underwriting, high limits of exposure and long-tailed loss profiles. The CLPM works closely with the underwriting business unit leaders, technology team, and finance and executive management to optimize MGA gross margin for the assigned P&C insurance programs through premium production, loss ratio management and operational efficiency. The CLPM has a thorough and comprehensive understanding of the coverages, rating mechanisms, business processes, systems and data for the assigned programs. The CLPM serves as a subject matter expert for policy data archived, transformed and reported using ISC’s data warehouse and business intelligence tools. The CLPM reports to the VP of Product Management and Actuarial.

Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain product scorecards to monitor key product performance indicators, evaluate scorecards to identify trends in program performance, opportunities, and actionable recommendations. Compile results to share with Business Unit leaders and company management.
  • Acquire Subject Matter Expertise on insured policy and claim data acquired by ISC and partner systems, including data retention and storage and reportability and visualization using ISC data warehouse and reporting tools. Use SQL, Python or other analytical applications to acquire, summarize and report policy, premium and loss data. Use data and information for reporting and analysis to develop insights, unearth opportunities, increase process efficiency and improve automation.
  • Work with underwriting business unit leaders to manage the rating plans, including ISO advisory rates and independent pricing. Employ pricing strategies and direction to aid the business unit leaders. Monitor and summarize premium and exposure trends and underwriter discretionary rating activity at the portfolio level. Analyze program metrics, underwriting insights and market environment to identify price segmentation opportunities. Lead the implementation efforts in conjunction with the Tech team.
  • Work with underwriting business unit leaders to manage the policy forms kits, including ISO, carrier-specific and proprietary policy forms and applications. Lead the implementation efforts in conjunction with the Tech team.
  • Work with underwriting business unit leaders and tech team to identify and describe requirements to streamline, structure and automate new and renewal underwriting and policy issuance processes applicable to agents or underwriters. Evaluate third-party data sources which may improve process efficiency or risk assessment.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Growth & Product Experience
jobs.desc:
About MacStadium
Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, MacStadium is the leading provider of private Mac cloud infrastructure, purpose-built for the Apple ecosystem. Our mission is to deliver cloud solutions that simplify Mac for business. We give enterprises, software teams, and independent developers dedicated access to genuine Apple hardware, without the overhead of procuring, racking, or managing it themselves, so they can build, test, and ship Apple platform software faster and more securely.
Our product portfolio spans macOS virtualization and orchestration (Orka), private Mac cloud and bare-metal compute, Mac Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI, including Citrix-based remote desktop access) for distributed teams, and dedicated Apple Silicon infrastructure for AI and machine learning workloads. We're trusted by organizations ranging from fast-growing startups to household names, and leading financial institutions, who rely on MacStadium to power their iOS, macOS, and cross-platform development pipelines at scale.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Product Manager to own and optimize the entire MacStadium user journey, ensuring customers easily discover the value of our Mac ecosystem, mobile development, and emerging technology solutions from first engagement through long-term retention. You'll focus on reducing churn, improving signup-to-meeting-to-purchase conversion, and strengthening the overall product experience by working cross-functionally with product domain experts, marketing, sales, and technical support and customer success.
As part of both product experience and growth, you'll seed and shape innovation initiatives in areas such as AI, clustering, and automation. You'll also take ownership of where MacStadium focuses its product design projects, ensuring high impact, consistency, and usability across the platform, including the experiences our Orka, Mac VDI/Citrix, and mobile development customers rely on every day.

What you will be doing

Product Experience:
  • Map and optimize the buyer and user journey, from first awareness to adoption, purchase, and retention, across MacStadium's Mac ecosystem and mobile development products.
  • Identify friction points in product discovery and usability, ensuring customers can quickly see how MacStadium's Mac infrastructure, virtualization, and mobile CI/CD offerings solve their needs.
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales to develop a strategic framework for product design that supports seamless continuity throughout the customer lifecycle.
Growth and Retention:
  • Work across departments to understand, analyze, and address the drivers of churn, and implement retention-focused improvements.
  • Lead an effort to improve signup-to-first-meeting and lead-to-purchase conversion rates, collaborating with marketing and sales on onboarding, messaging, and trial experiences for prospective Mac infrastructure and mobile development customers.
  • Identify opportunities to increase customer engagement and expansion across MacStadium's product portfolio.
Customer & Market Discovery:
  • Run continuous customer and market discovery to surface unmet needs and underserved workflows across the use of Apple in an enterprise environment, including customer interviews, win/loss reviews, and deciphering signals from sales and support.

Engineering Product Manager - Audio Software
Music Technology / Audio AI
Remote working from anywhere
This is a key role for an Engineering Product Manager to join a music software companyworking on one of the most exciting and popular music production tools on the market. It's a great time to join them as they continue to grow, and establish themselves as one of the most innovative software tools for music producers and songwriters.

You need to have a strong, hands-on software engineering background, a detailed understanding of music production and audio workflow tools, and a great track record delivering innovative software to creative users.
Experience leading engineering and product teams in a quickly growing company is a plus.

Requirements

  • Track record delivering commercially successful software tools in a lead role
  • Experience working with C++, JUCE, JavaScript and Python
  • Detailed understanding of audio processing
  • Successful technical leadership and product management experience
  • Excellent team motivator, manager and coordinator
  • Able to work, lead and collaborate remotely

jobs.title: Product Management MBA Intern, Data Center GPU - Summer 2027
Junior Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten)
jobs.desc:
What to expect


Caspar Health ist führend in der digitalen Reha-Nachsorge. Wir entwickeln Lösungen, die eine moderne, datengestützte Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen und die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Zuhause schlagen. Unsere App bietet Patient*innen die Freiheit, ihre Nachsorge zeitlich flexibel und ortsunabhängig zu gestalten – individuell begleitet durch unser therapeutisches Team.

Als Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten) gestaltest du die digitale Transformation im deutschen Gesundheitswesen aktiv mit. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbaren Impact, denn jedes Feature, das du entwickelst, zahlt direkt auf den Genesungsweg von Menschen ein. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Design, Engineering und Data durchläufst du alle Facetten eines modernen Produktzyklus – von der ersten Hypothese bis zum Release. Du arbeitest hands-on mit Prototypen, nutzt Experimente zum Lernen und stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Nutzer*innen. So erlebst du unmittelbar, welchen wertvollen Unterschied deine Arbeit für das Leben von Patient:innen und die Zukunftsfähigkeit unseres Gesundheitssystems macht.

Diese Rolle ist perfekt für dich, wenn...

  • ...du den direkten Kontakt liebst: Wöchentliche Nutzerinterviews sind für dich kein Pflichttermin, sondern deine wichtigste Inspirationsquelle

  • ...du Geschwindigkeit schätzt: Schnelles Prototyping und Shipping motivieren dich mehr als monatelange Konzeptionsphasen

  • ...du mutig entscheidest: Du fühlst dich wohl dabei, auch bei unvollständiger Datenlage die Richtung vorzugeben und durch Iteration zu lernen





Your Challenges


  • Werde zur Stimme unserer Nutzer*innen: Du führst eigenständig Interviews mit Patient*innen und sprichst regelmäßig mit Ärzt*innen und Kliniken. Du tauchst tief in ihre Lebensrealität ein, analysierst ihre Herausforderungen und übersetzt echte Gespräche in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, die den Genesungsweg spürbar verbessern

  • Gestalte die Therapie von morgen: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie mit Experimenten und Prototypen – und baust gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering echte Lösungen, die in unserer App live gehen. Du begleitest Features vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Release und darüber hinaus

  • Wachse in die Verantwortung für deinen Squad: Gemeinsam mit Design, Tech und Medizin moderierst du den Weg von der ersten Idee bis zum Release. Du lernst, wie man Klarheit schafft und Hindernisse aus dem Weg räumt, damit ihr am Ende gemeinsam den Erfolg eurer Arbeit feiern könnt

  • Sorge für Transparenz und Vertrauen: Du kommunizierst Fortschritte und Hürden offen. Dein Ziel ist es, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen und eine Basis zu schaffen, auf der wir unsere Produktvision Schritt für Schritt gemeinsam in die Realität umsetzen

  • Arbeite datengetrieben und zeige Impact: Du definierst Erfolgskriterien, analysierst Metriken und ziehst klare Schlüsse aus Nutzer- und Produktdaten. Deine Insights fließen direkt in Entscheidungen ein und helfen uns, Impact messbar zu machen – für Patient:innen, Kliniken und das Unternehmen

  • Präge unsere Roadmap aktiv mit: Mit deinen Nutzer-Insights und datenbasierten Lösungen beeinflusst du Prioritäten und Produktentscheidungen direkt. Du bringst Themen proaktiv ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Team, woran wir als Nächstes arbeiten

  • Übernehme Ownership für Engagement, Verständlichkeit und Fortschritt im Patient:innen-Erlebnis: Du identifizierst zentrale Paint
